verifications.claim: Darden Restaurants is closing or converting all of its remaining 28 Bahama Breeze locations.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Darden Restaurants announced it is shuttering all 28 of its remaining Bahama Breeze locations. Fourteen locations will be permanently closed... while the other 14 will be converted (R1); permanently close 14 Bahama Breeze restaurants and plans to convert the remaining 14 locations (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state 14 closing and 14 converting, totaling all 28 remaining locations.

verifications.claim: Darden Restaurants finalized major changes to its Bahama Breeze locations by April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: The 14 restaurants designated for permanent closure are expected to continue operating through April 5, 2026. The company anticipates converting the remaining 14 locations over the next 12-18 months (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Closures expected by April 5, but conversions occur over 12-18 months beyond that date; changes not finalized by April 5.

verifications.claim: Darden Restaurants announced that the Bahama Breeze chain is no longer a strategic priority.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The company stated last year that the Bahama Breeze chain was no longer a strategic priority (R1); Previously, the company announced that the Bahama Breeze brand... were no longer a strategic priority (R2); Darden Restaurants says all 28 locations were “no longer a strategic priority” (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements in multiple sources confirm the announcement.

verifications.claim: Darden Restaurants announced it will shutter 14 Bahama Breeze locations.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Darden Restaurants announced it will permanently close 14 Bahama Breeze restaurants (R2); Darden to shutter 14 locations (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently stated across sources that 14 locations will be shuttered/closed permanently.

verifications.claim: Darden Restaurants announced it will convert the remaining 14 Bahama Breeze locations into other brands over the next 12-18 months.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: plans to convert the remaining 14 locations into another Darden brand... over the next 12-18 months (R2); the other 14 will be converted to other Darden brands... over the next 12 to 18 months (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Exact details match announcements in primary sources.

verifications.claim: The 14 Bahama Breeze locations slated for permanent closure continued operating through April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: expected to continue operating through April 5, 2026 (R2); the Sanford location, as well as the Bahama Breeze on West Osceola Parkway, closed Sunday [March 15] (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources state they were 'expected to' operate through April 5, but others report at least two closed early, creating contradiction.

verifications.claim: Some Bahama Breeze locations closed prior to April 5, 2026, to allow for staff transfers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: One of the reasons why they closed earlier was that staff were already being given opportunities to work at other Darden locations... staff were already being given opportunities to work at other Darden locations (R5, R6)
verifications.reasoning: Direct reports confirm early closures for staff transfer reasons.

verifications.claim: 14 Bahama Breeze locations are in the process of being converted into other Darden brands over the next 12-18 months.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The company anticipates converting the remaining 14 locations over the next 12-18 months. They are expected to continue to operate until any temporary closures are needed for the conversion (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm the plan and ongoing nature post-announcement.
